scope:
Conditional architecture accounts; pulse-size extrapolations are requirements.

All source energy, including recovered driver energy, enters once. Mass ratings
are explicit acceptance allocations. No Monte Carlo whole-design interval.

central_cycle.scope: Conditional constant-cp cycle. Component maps, actual fluid mixture/properties, seals, recuperator axial conduction, bypass/leakage, cooler pressure loss allocation and lifetime need design. Pressure losses are included once via reduced expansion ratio. No whole-station net-power result.

strong_cycle.scope: Conditional constant-cp cycle. Component maps, actual fluid mixture/properties, seals, recuperator axial conduction, bypass/leakage, cooler pressure loss allocation and lifetime need design. Pressure losses are included once via reduced expansion ratio. No whole-station net-power result.

cold_equipment_requirements.qualification: Linear photon/particle throughput, unchanged guide interception and chosen gas collection/repair laws. Area multiplication is a capacity scenario. New temperature-dependent leakage, bank cycling, capture and refrigerator apparatus need design. Coolant header pumping is inside the engine package pump allocation.
